sara ng: Heads up — Q4 demand model updated, shows ~35% bump in GPU hours vs baseline. H200 lead times just slid to ~18-22 weeks from vendor X. We need a procurement prioritization and short-term mitigation playbook.

jia k: Quick numbers: baseline monthly GPU hours = 120k, Q4 forecast ~162k (seasonal + product launches). Peak daily token throughput suggests ~350 H200-equivalent cards if we solely relied on H200.

mike chen: Cost context: H200 unit cost + power ~1.6x H100. For our dense decoding workloads, H200 reduces per-token cost ~15-25% vs H100. L40S cheaper per-card but increases tail latency; good for batch embeddings. Need ROI for reservation vs lease.

owen: Region constraints — APAC shipments facing customs delays; realistic lead-time bump +3 weeks. Also EU rack space is tight in NOV. We should plan to shift non-latency batch traffic to us-east during surge.

infra-bot: Reservation snapshot (automated): Reserved H100: 420 units, Reserved H200: 80 units, Reserved L40S: 200 units. Backorder alerts: H200 supplier X +14 days delay.

jia k: Proposed short-term playbook:
1) Prioritize H100 reservations for latency-critical routes, supplement with leased H200 for throughput where ROI is clear.
2) Short lease spike for 8-12 weeks to cover Q4 ramp while longer H200 orders arrive.
3) Reserve extra L40S capacity in EU for embeddings to reduce cost.
4) Open RFQs to 3 vendors and start blanket POs to lock lead time windows.

sara ng: Action items: @mike chen — run reservation ROI scenarios by EOD (3 variants: aggressive H200, mixed, H100-first). @owen — confirm APAC shipping buffer & confirm racks/IPs needed. @jia k — update per-model GPU-hour burn and upload spreadsheet. I'll prep a 1-slide exec summary for Tuesday.

mike chen: On the ROI variants. Quick note: leasing H100 spot capacity for short term may carry ~12% premium vs committed H200; I'll include blended unit-cost curves.

owen: APAC shipping buffer + customs = +3 weeks added. Also need to request /26 for the extra racks if we scale beyond 48 hosts in SIN. Pinging net team.

jia k: Forecast calc snippet I'm using:
```
Q4_hours = baseline * 1.35 + seasonal_campaign_hours
H200_cards = ceil(Q4_hours / effective_hours_per_card)
```
I'll push the sheet and link in the thread.

sara ng: :thumbsup: Good. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize the vendor prioritize list. If anyone sees sudden supplier changes, ping #vendors and @sara immediately.
